tasks.label: Run git remote add origin
tasks.command: if (& 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' remote get-url origin 2>$null) { & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' remote set-url origin 'https://github.com/PRAKASHRAIKWAR/khelMP.git' } else { & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' remote add origin 'https://github.com/PRAKASHRAIKWAR/khelMP.git' }

tasks.label: Commit and push VS Code task
tasks.command: $git = 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; & $git add -- '.vscode/tasks.json'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $git commit -m 'Add VS Code Git tasks' -m 'Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $git push origin main; exit $LASTEXITCODE
